title: The Custom Formatters module allows users to easily create custom Field Formatters through an admin UI without writing a custom module. (CVE-2026-114524)
description: The Custom Formatters module for Drupal allows users to create custom Field Formatters via an admin UI without needing to write a custom module. It executes user-provided PHP code using eval(), enabling arbitrary PHP code execution on the site. The permissions interface does not warn users about this capability. Versions prior to 4.2.1 are affected. A patch is available to address this issue.
aiSummary: The vulnerability in the Drupal Custom Formatters module (CVE-2026-114524) arises because the PHP formatter engine uses eval() to run user-supplied PHP code, allowing arbitrary PHP execution. This occurs through the admin UI for creating custom Field Formatters, which does not clearly indicate the security implications in its permissions UI. This flaw affects all versions before 4.2.1 of the module.
aiImpact: An attacker with access to the admin UI can execute arbitrary PHP code on the affected Drupal site, potentially leading to full site compromise. The lack of clear permission warnings increases the risk of inadvertent exposure to this vulnerability.
